deskripsi: Witness history and experience motorsport like never before—where world-class drivers go head-to-head in explosive, wheel-to-wheel battles on a high-intensity mixed-surface track. Feel the roar of engines, the adrenaline of every corner, and the thrill of racing just meters away. More than a race, the inaugural FIA Rallycross World Cup Indonesia 2026 is a high-octane spectacl that redefines live motorsport at its most electrifying form. Secure your tickets now and be part of history.

MDRT Day 2026 greets Jakarta again on July 15 2026, with the theme "The Unshakable" with the hope that all MDRT friends will remain steadfast and never give up in facing challenges in order to achieve MDRT, COT and TOT targets in 2026. With an extraordinary line-up of speakers, a combination of producers and builders. MDRT Day is ready to share fresh strategies and creative ideas for your business growth. ​Let's prepare ourselves to grow together. See you at MDRT Day 2026 by MCC Indonesia!

Joyland Sessions returns in 2026 with another carefully curated weekend of music, culture, and immersive experiences. Expect a genre-spanning lineup, special moments, and the signature Joyland atmosphere — all coming together for two unforgettable days in Jakarta.

Ruang Raya is a festival that brings together music, community, culinary and local creativity in one celebration. More than just a concert, Ruang Raya is a space for everyone to gather, express and create unforgettable moments. ”Lighting Up the Space, Celebrating the City.”

Experience science like never before with the STEAMtech Science Show at the Jakarta Planetarium, Taman Ismail Marzuki! Interactive Science Show with LIVE experiments! Fun, educational and suitable for all ages. Participants will explore the basics of science through an exciting STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts & Mathematics) based approach, making education fun and memorable. INSTAGRAM : @STEAMTECHEDU

"Glitter Camp Live Concert" carries the concept of an intimate concert with a touch of modern and colorful visuals, to a stage atmosphere created with a modern and warm camp atmosphere. Not only will it be a showcase for performances of glitter songs, "Glitter Camp Live Concert" will also be a playground for each Glitter personnel and the Glitz members.

THE LANGHAM PINK RUN 2026 Join us for The Langham Pink Run 2026, a vibrant 5K charity run held in celebration of the 161st Anniversary of The Langham Hotels & Resorts. More than just a run, this meaningful event aims to raise awareness and support for breast cancer advocacy through our charity partner, Love Pink Indonesia, a foundation dedicated to educating, empowering, and supporting individuals affected by breast cancer across Indonesia. Gather your friends, family, and fellow runners for a morning filled with energy, wellness, and purpose. Participants can enjoy an exciting lineup of activities, including an invigorating Dance Icon Cardio session, while also standing a chance to win fantastic door prizes and giveaways throughout the event. Whether you're an experienced runner or simply looking to make a difference, every step you take helps support a meaningful cause. Event supported by: BRI (Bank Rakyat Indonesia) Luxmatters Jewellery, Brilliant by Langham, Ron 88, Shiseido, Asics, Biore UV, Heavenly Blush, Ultrajaya, District8, Magnum

judul: KAHITNA INTIMATE CONCERT BY BENGKEL HALL x 3 ELEVENT
deskripsi: Bengkel Live proudly presents: INTIMATE CONCERT — KAHITNA A night where timeless melodies meet unforgettable memories. Experience the warmth, romance, and nostalgia of Kahitna in an exclusive intimate concert at Bengkel Hall. Sing along to the songs that have become the soundtrack of countless love stories and create new memories in a setting that brings you closer to the music than ever before.

Amaranta Trail Walk 2026 An Exclusive Trail Walking Experience in Sunset Day / Date : Saturday / 18 July 2026 Time : 15.00 - finish Location : Amaranta Prambanan Yogyakarta, Jalan Dawangsari no 45, Sleman, D.I.Yogyakarta For further information about this event, go to https://amarantatrailwalk.com or Instagram @amarantatrailwalk

judul: Men I Trust Asia Tour 2026: Live In Jakarta
deskripsi: After a completely sold out show in 2023, Men I Trust is finally returning to Jakarta for the Asia Tour 2026. Bringing along their newest album and signature dreamy sound, the beloved indie trio will take over Tennis Indoor Senayan on 12 November 2026 for a night of hypnotic melodies, intimate moments, and nostalgic energy. Known for their atmospheric performances and fan-favorite tracks that have soundtracked listeners around the world, Men I Trust’s return promises an even more special experience for Jakarta fans. Expect a set filled with both new songs and timeless favorites, wrapped in the band’s warm and immersive live atmosphere.

Suaraga is a collaborative space built to be a catalyst for feelings and experiences. A movement that is determined to strengthen the community, economy and identity of the city so that it becomes stronger and spreads a wider positive impact. Initiated by three creative entities; Vindes Corp, Pestapora (Boss Creator), and Maliq & D'Essentials (Mad Haus) a consortium that represents the elements of Voice, Work and Body. Held on 4 - 5 July at Balekambang Park, Surakarta. Let's achieve calm and harmonize our souls together, at the Suaraga festival.

lokasi: Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Indonesia
deskripsi: The Oldest and Biggest Student-Led Festival, The 49th Jazz Goes to Campus is Back! As the longest-running student-led jazz festival in Indonesia, we are returning with even greater energy. This year marks a monumental milestone as we take our final step before the golden anniversary of Jazz Goes to Campus. Carrying the theme "Resonating Jazz Through Every Soul", we invite you to a festival where music transcends boundaries. Expect a diverse lineup of legendary musicians and rising stars, delivering the true spirit of jazz directly to the iconic campus grounds. Be part of the legacy and witness the biggest celebration of music, community, and freedom of expression. Date: 8th November 2026 Location: FEB UI CAMPUS GROUND Regular Tickets are open for Presale 1 Get your tickets now only on Loket.com! See you on 8th November 2026, Jazzmates! Social Media Tiktok @jgtcfestival Instagram @jgtcfestival X @jgtcfestival

Fortune Investment Forum 2026 is a one-day premium investment forum designed to help investors navigate global trends and allocate capital with clarity, discipline, and conviction. The forum covers the full spectrum of today’s investment universe, from public markets and fixed income to crypto and digital assets, private capital, commodities, and real assets. Through forward-looking insights and expert perspectives, participants will gain a structured understanding of the macroeconomic landscape, cross-asset opportunities, and key frameworks for making informed investment decisions amid evolving market conditions. judul: Hillsong Worship Nights Asia Tour Surabaya
organizer: Otello Asia dan Color Asia Live
deskripsi: For the first time in Surabaya, Hillsong Worship is present as part of the Asia Tour 2026. A special night that will unite thousands of hearts in praise and worship through songs that have been a blessing to millions of people around the world. Enjoy live iconic songs such as What A Beautiful Name, Oceans (Where Feet May Fail), Who You Say I Am, Cornerstone, and King of Kings in a worship experience full of joy, hope, and inspiration. This special night will be an unforgettable experience for thousands of churches, families, and Christian communities who will gather together in one heart to praise and worship God.

Experience Afgan like never before is a bold reimagining of his greatest works, brought to life through an ambitious collaboration with the Erwin Gutawa Orchestra. Familiar songs are transformed into powerful orchestral arrangements, where sweeping strings, bold brass sections, and rich rhythmic textures move in harmony with Afgan’s signature vocals. Featuring reimagined performances from all hits, this concert reveals deeper emotion and a grander sonic scale than ever before. More than just a concert, this is a creative milestone an immersive musical journey that redefines what an Afgan live experience can be.

judul: ISYANA SARASVATI LIVE IN KUALA LUMPUR
deskripsi: Experience the eclectic universe of Isyana Sarasvati live in Kuala Lumpur. As Isyana Sarasvati returns to Kuala Lumpur, audiences will be taken on a musical journey through the many chapters of her artistry, bringing together timeless favourites, bold new sounds, and the expressive live performances that define her stage presence. With her signature genre-blending music, powerful vocals, and immersive energy, Isyana invites Kuala Lumpur into an unforgettable evening filled with emotion, intensity, and surprise.

Bengkel Live proudly presents: LOVE & LOSE — JUICY LUICY LIVE IN CONCERT Some stories end, but the feelings never do. Experience a night of heartfelt lyrics and unforgettable melodies as Juicy Luicy brings Love & Lose to life at Bengkel Hall—a celebration of music, memories, and the journey we’ve shared together.
